## Checklist

- [ ] My PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org), e.g. `feat(sessions): add week 6 notebook`
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (or CI is green)
- [ ] Notebooks run top to bottom and are committed without outputs
- [ ] Links work, and new terms are in the [glossary](https://github.com/GDG-TUM/AI-ML-Track-GDG-on-Campus-TUM/blob/main/resources/glossary.md)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, personal data, datasets or model weights

## Responsible AI

- [ ] I checked data sources, licences and consent
- [ ] I thought about who could be harmed if the output is wrong
